verdict.rationale: Asana's documented REST API returns JSON, and official JavaScript/Python libraries support pagination, so a user can programmatically pull workspace data in an open format. Third-party connectors listed in its directory (Fivetran, Airbyte, Skyvia backup) can also extract Asana data into warehouses, but this means building your own export or relying on extra tools rather than a first-party bulk export. Missing for 10: a documented native full-account or workspace export (e.g. CSV/JSON bulk download), evidence that the export covers all data types (attachments, comments, history), and hands-on corroboration of a complete migration out.
